delta.title: S1 Copilot supervisor: safety contracts + characterization baseline (P0)

delta.reason: PR #325 Copilot finding 1 (critical shipment safety): covering feature 117-F was an explicit member of the 124-S manifest. backlogit ShipShipment marks and archives a covering feature only when it is an explicit manifest member (explicitScope gate, 133-F/133.004-T), so closing S1 would have closed and archived 117-F while 14 of its 19 children remained unshipped in 125-S/126-S. All three Plan-1 shipments are now task-only manifests; the covering feature is derived through task parent_id.
